root_idea.summary: The root centers on cutting, trimming, and shaping a hard material, especially by paring or sharpening it.
root_idea.development: From trimming and sharpening came قَلَم for a writing reed prepared by cutting, and, by resemblance, for a lot-arrow used in casting lots. Related lexical branches name clippings, trimmed extremities, and figurative weakness; قُلَام is recorded as a divergent plant term.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The singular citation form قَلَم represents the Quranic plural and case-inflected occurrences.

senses.definition: A pen, especially a writing reed or other implement used for writing.
senses.usage_conditions: Includes the plural أَقْلَام; Quranic occurrences refer to writing instruments used generally or collectively.

senses.definition: A lot-arrow or casting stick used for drawing lots.
senses.usage_conditions: In the construction إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَامَهُمْ, the plural denotes arrows or sticks cast to determine a selection, rather than writing pens.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cut, trim, pare, or smooth a hard thing by cutting or sharpening it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported applications include trimming a nail; the doubled form قَلَّمَ is also used for this action.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing that has been clipped or cut down.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A result noun or descriptor for something subjected to trimming.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A clipping cut from a nail during trimming.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Refers to the piece that falls away when the nail is clipped.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A weak or powerless person, literally described as having clipped nails.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative idiomatic expression for weakness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The tip of a camel’s qinb; also the knobs or joints of a spear.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Specialized anatomical and spear terminology associated with a clipped or shaped extremity.
Recorded as a lexical branch divergent from the root’s main cutting-and-shaping sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One of the seven regions or climes into which the inhabited world was divided in an ancient geographical scheme.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical geographical term in the seven-region model attributed to astronomers.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Pointer-only cross-reference to جَلَمٌ; it supplies no independent lexical definition.
Defines the writing reed or pen.
Pointer-only cross-reference to ظُفْرٌ; it gives no definition of its own.

cautions: A reported theological association of the pen with a primordial or divine writing instrument is not treated as a separate lexical sense; it concerns the referent and theology rather than the noun’s basic meaning.
